data.long_meaning: Devi (Goddess) + Hita (Divine Being, Delight). Devhita represents a divine being, a goddess or a being blessed by gods. In Hindu mythology, she is believed to bring joy and happiness. The name Devhita carries the meaning “Goddess, divine being” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devhita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess, divine being and live with faith, good character and purpose.
